description: This file defines the SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector class, which implements IPlacementDirector to handle placement logic based on silo roles in Orleans runtime. It manages placement of silos for grains with role-based constraints, utilizing the membership table to find compatible silos and handling placement hints.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implementation of IPlacementDirector that handles silo placement based on their role, ensuring grains are assigned to silos with matching roles and active status.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the placement director with the MembershipTableManager instance.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the logic for placing a new grain activation on an appropriate silo based on role and availability, considering placement hints.
